note: Wooded family campground on Blue Mound, the highest point in southern Wisconsin, with a summer swimming pool in the park and a trail link to the Military Ridge State Trail. Part of the campground stays open in winter, but winter campers park at the campground entrance and walk to their sites. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page, park page and campground map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 78 drive-in sites, 32 electric (amperage not stated), showers, flush and vault toilets, dump. Winter camping is walk-in only, so the stored year-round season does not hold for an RV. Pin sits in the campground. Phone confirmed.
